Bund Office Complex, Delhi. Estimated Cost: ₹81,86,113/- (Rupees Eighty-One Lakh Eighty Six Thousan d One Hundred Thirteen Only) Contract Duration: 12 Months (365 Days) 1. SCOPE OF WORK (SoW) The objective of this contract is to maintain a high level of cleanliness, hygiene, aesth etic presentation, and uninterrupted operational efficiency of water supply, plumbing, electrical installations, and horticultural assets across the entire Headquarter Office p remises of the Irrigation & Flood Control Department, GNCTD, situated at L.M. Bund Office Complex, Delhi. The scope covers the Office of the Secretary (I&FC), Chief Engi neer (I&FC), Superintending Engineer (FC-I), and Civil Divisions CD-III, CD-IV, CD-XIV, and CD-XVIII. A. Summary of Deployed Manpower & Services (Man-Months / Year)

S.No. Category / Role Skill Level Monthly Dep Annual Man- loyment Months 1 Sweepers (Housekeeping & Unskilled 14 Persons 168 Man-Mont Cleaning) hs 2 Plumber (Water Supply & D Skilled 1 Person 12 Man-Month rainage) s 3 Electrician (Electrical Syste Skilled 1 Person 12 Man-Month ms) s 4 Gardeners (Horticulture & Skilled 2 Persons 24 Man-Month Lawns) s 5 Helpers (Assisting Staff) Unskilled 4 Persons 48 Man-Month s 6 Supervisor (Monitoring & M Supervisory 1 Person 12 Man-Month anagement) s B. Operational Scope by Discipline i. Housekeeping & Sweeping Services (14 Sweepers): Comprehensive sweepi ng, brooming, and damp-mopping of all office floors, corridors, staircases, lobbies, and executive cabins across O/o Secretary (I&FC), Chief Engineer, SE (FC-I), and D ivisions CD-III, IV, XIV, and XVIII using manual/mechanical means. Regular washin g, cleaning, and sanitizing of attached and common toilet blocks using high-grade germicides and applicable equipment and tools. Sweeping of internal road stretch es (Gate No. 1 to Gate No. 2), authorized parking lots, pathways, open spaces, an d garden surroundings within the complex using manual/mechanical means. Daily collection and segregation of routine office waste and disposal to designated muni cipal dumping points using manual/mechanical means as per the directions of Eng ineer-in-charge. ii. Plumbing & Sanitary Systems (1 Plumber + 1 Helper): Continuous inspect ion, preventive maintenance, and repair of water supply networks, distribution pip elines, valves, taps, bib cocks, flush valves, cisterns, and sanitary fixtures. Regula r cleaning, unblocking, and upkeep of overhead water storage tanks, float valves, and drainage systems. Prompt attendance to choking, leakage, low pressure, or o verflowing tanks. Major material replacements beyond minor routine maintenance shall be executed with prior approval of the Engineer-in-Charge. iii. Electrical Maintenance (1 Electrician + 1 Helper): Routine monitoring, rep air, and maintenance of electrical wiring, distribution boards, MCBs, ELCBs, switch es, sockets, and circuit breakers. Maintenance of interior/exterior lighting fixtures, LED tube lights, streetlights, ceiling fans, wall fans, and exhaust fans. Troubleshoo ting power failures, voltage fluctuations, short circuits, and loose connections whil e enforcing strict electrical safety protocols.

iv. Horticulture & Gardening (2 Gardeners + 2 Helpers): Regular watering, m owing, edge trimming, and weeding of lawns, flower beds, and green belts. Prunin g of shrubs and hedges, pest control inspection of plants, and systematic collectio n and disposal of garden green waste. v. Overall Supervision (1 Supervisor): Direct monitoring of daily attendance, ta sk rosters, site checks, complaint registration, quality assurance, and liaisoning wi th departmental officers/Engineer-in-Charge. The deployed Supervisor shall be a Graduate or above and shall possess adequate experience in supervising houseke eping, maintenance and allied activities. The agency shall ensure that the Supervi sor is capable of maintaining attendance records, duty rosters, complaint register s and coordination with departmental officials. vi. Machinery, Equipment & Consumables Package: The agency shall supply and maintain all requisite machines and monthly consumables, including Wet/Dry Vacuum Cleaners, Mechanized Mopping Machines, Glass Cleaning Kits, Kentucky Mops, M-Fold Paper Dispensers, Branded Disinfectants/Cleaners (Taski/Diversey/C olin/Harpic equivalent), Biodegradable Garbage Bags, Urinal Cubes, Air Freshener s, etc. The Service Provider shall arrange and provide all necessary machinery, eq uipment, tools, implements, materials and consumables required for the satisfacto ry execution of housekeeping, plumbing, electrical, horticultural and allied mainte nance activities at the Headquarter Office of I&FC Department, GNCTD, situated a t L.M. Bund Office Complex, Delhi. The Service Provider shall provide the required machinery and equipment at the commencement of the contract and submit proo f of procurement/deployment to the Engineer-in-Charge. All costs towards procure ment, transportation, maintenance, replacement, consumables, contractor's profit and applicable taxes shall be deemed included in the quoted amount for this com ponent. No additional payment shall be admissible on this account. C. LABOUR LAW COMPLIANCES i. The engagement and employment of labourers and payment of wages to the m as per existing provisions of various Labour Laws and Regulations are the so le responsibility of the contractor and any breach of such laws or regulations s hall be deemed to be breach of this contract. The Department may ask the con tractor to produce documents to verify that these provisions/laws are complied with by the contractor. (a) All wages and allied benefits such as Leave, ESI, PF, Gratuity, Bonus etc, sh all be paid by the contractor and the Department shall not incur any liability or additional expenditure, whatsoever for personnel deployed, (b) It is mandatory that the employees must be paid through bank/cheques/EC S only in terms of instruction of the Labour Commissioner. ii. The contractor shall abide by all labour laws, laws related to EPF Organisation, ESI Corporation, Workmen Compensation Act. The details of EPF, ESIC in respe ct of their deployed staff shall be submitted by the contractor to the Departme nt every month along with the bill. The contractor shall abide, including but not limited to, matters relating to timely payment of wages and allowances, paym ent of minimum wages, payment of overtime, grant of leave, payment of work men's compensation, working hours, safety, maternity benefits, holidays, frami ng of standing orders, disciplinary action against employees, payment of provi dent fund contributions, payment of gratuities and payment of bonus. iii. The contractor shall be liable for any legal dispute/ case / claims that arises or may arise during currency of the contract due to non-compliances of labour or other related laws. iv. The contractor shall be responsible for compliance of all the laws/ rules/ regula tions and Govt. instructions that are/ shall be applicable to and aimed to prote ct the interest of the employees/ workers, engaged by it and shall ensure pay ment of all the statutory dues/ liabilities as may have arisen during the past 'or

' may arise during, the course of performance of the contract. v. The contractor shall submit periodical returns as may be specified from time t o time. D.
